about_the_game:
In a world where humanity has lost the war against the machines, only scattered survivors remain — hiding, starving, resisting. You are the Incursor, a ruthless robotic enforcer sent by the AI overlords to wipe out what's left of mankind.

But you're not alone. At your side floats ORB, a deadly spherical companion that can morph into devastating ranged weapons, from rapid-fire machine guns to piercing sniper beams. Together, you'll crush the last human strongholds in a world broken by war.

SHAPE YOUR DESTRUCTION

Choose from a brutal arsenal of melee weapons, unleash devastating relics with game-changing effects, and gather rare mods to reconfigure ORB into new instruments of annihilation. Every run is a chance to craft a different path of destruction.

EVOLVE. ADAPT. SURVIVE.

Unlock powerful skills in a sprawling ability tree, stack relics for unpredictable combos, and tailor your combat style to fit the chaos ahead. No two battles, or builds, are ever the same.

FACE RELENTLESS ENEMIES

From berserker brutes to calculating tacticians, each enemy class demands new strategies. Adapt quickly, or become just another pile of scrap.

A WORLD IN RUINS

Explore a procedurally assembled wasteland where every cell you enter is hand-crafted yet shuffled for endless replayability. Every step forward hides new traps, ambushes, and opportunities to grow stronger.

⚡ Brutal melee combat meets rogue-lite replayability.
⚡ A robotic companion that transforms into your deadliest weapon.
⚡ Relics, skills, and mods that twist every run into something new.
⚡ A decayed world where AI rules — and humanity is prey.

The future belongs to the machines.
Make sure no human lives to see it.

name: Kill Code

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)

short_description: Hunt the last remnants of humanity in a world shattered by war. Master brutal melee weapons, unleash powerful relics, and transform ORB your deadly robotic companion into the ultimate weapon of destruction.
supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support
